text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing,
we passed by some lively pedestrians.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Dee is opening a physical pop-up shop, for real?!
They usually only do online mail-orders!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yup! But apparently it's a pop-up stall!
I got a tip that it's around here!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, if it isn't Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Fuji! Did you happen to see
an accessory stall around here!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Dee!
I was just on my way there myself!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
He's a popular accessory artist.
His pieces are so sought after that there's even a legend of them selling out within a minute of going on sale...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Explanations can wait!
Just hurry up!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap, they actually set up a booth...!
I was just browsing their site, too!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Dee's stuff has its quirks, but once you get hooked, you can't put it down.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Those chain earrings are his work too, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: How do you know that?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because I like enjoying all kinds of outfits.
I always keep an eye out for styles
that are different from what I normally wear!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Oh, they're selling those ear cuffs again!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's the legendary item that sold out immediately!
The silver ring next to it is super rare too!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
!
Then did you also know about the one right next to it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, it's that limited-edition set with the anti-eyebrow and
eyebrow piercings, isn't it! Your, um..."
choice_data_list: Ah, that's just like Shakur's eyebrow piercing!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Takes me back. The day this arrived,
I booked an appointment at a piercing studio right away to get pierced."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Haven't done an anti-eyebrow yet, but...
One of these days, I'm definitely takin' the plunge!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, they're even selling one-time limited-edition goods!
And look at this design!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Could this be a matching design
with the necklace sold previously?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
!!
I knew it, right!?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you even know that much?
You're quite the hardcore fan, aren't ya...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm honored by the praise!
I just happened to have it with me, and inspiration struck.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Ain't that design easy enough even for you to wear?
It's a limited edition, so if you pass it up now, who knows if you'll ever get another chance?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur was in a good mood the entire time,
and Fuji Kiseki and I were able to enjoy shopping alongside her...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu, we ended up buying way more than expected!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Did I buy too much on impulse?
That was a big expense... but still.
choice_data_list: I'm glad you could buy one you liked!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Ha, yeah, well.
It was a necessary expense. I don't regret it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Whether I have this or not
makes a huge difference to my condition. Thinking about it that way...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: If anything, it's a cheap bargain.
choice_data_list: Which one should I put on first?
Which one should I put on first?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: If anything, it's a cheap bargain.
choice_data_list: Which one should I put on first?
Which one should I put on first?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, when you say it,
it just sounds so smooth...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Well, whatever.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Shopping with an Air Shakur who seemed to be having fun
was truly a rare experience...!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Who cares which one it is?
Why the hell do I gotta tell you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying that, she refused to tell me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Later on, she seemed to love every accessory and was frequently seen wearing them.
